## 問題
App 通路在 2025 年 12 月的有效訂單數？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 1446
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，通路為 orders.channel = 'app'，時間以 order_ts 加 8 小時換算台北時間後篩 2025-12，並以不重複 order_id 計張數。已對照 payments：status 1/2/3 的訂單皆有付款成功紀錄，付款 ok 的筆數加總同為 1446。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_ts, status, channel FROM orders LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS app_valid_orders_2025_12 FROM orders WHERE channel = 'app' AND status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-12'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_ts, status, channel FROM orders LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_ts', 'status', 'channel'], 'rows': [['2025-05-27 02:32:55', 3, 'app'], ['2025-06-01 06:04:51', 3, 'web'], ['2025-09-27 08:46:07', 3, 'store'], ['2025-04-09 20:13:13', 3, 'web'], ['2025-12-31 14:44:12', 0, 'web']], 
SQL 2: ["SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'app' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-12' GROUP BY o.status, p.payment_status", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS app_valid_orders_2025_12_no_payment_filter FROM orders o WHERE o.channel = 'app' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-12'"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'app' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-12' GROUP BY o.status, p.payment_status", 

## 回答 B
最終答案: 1446
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，「App 通路」對應 orders.channel = 'app'，「有效訂單」為 status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單。時間以台北時間（UTC+8）換算後篩選 2025-12，共 1446 筆。
SQL 1: SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_app_orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'app' AND status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) = '2025-12'
  結果: {'columns': ['valid_app_orders'], 'rows': [[1446]], 'truncated': False}

response: 兩個回答答案相同，定義相同。A 多做了 payments 驗證與 DISTINCT，略為更嚴謹。B 簡潔正確。A 的 SQL 結果被截斷，但答案一致。A 的交叉驗證增加可信度。我會選 A 略勝，或 tie。A 有額外驗證，選 A。
